lines: 久等了！{be01}\n交给我的宝可梦们\n全都变得精力充沛了哦！
你好呀，训练家！\n你的笑容很灿烂。

Hello there, Trainer!
You’ve got a wonderful smile, there.{be01}
I have a hobby - collecting the profiles
of Pokémon Trainers.
